source_review_summary.reviewed_slice: PR97 Decision Trail Local-Private Specialist Output Pilot v0
source_review_summary.private_context_risk: include-text packet was private, large, and partly truncated

gate_decision.rationale: PR97 made the specialist lane useful enough to continue, but it also exposed missing contract fields and packet-scope metadata that should be patched before any broader batch.

pr97_useful_signal: Captured the authority-transfer versus reset-testing decision shape.
Preserved stakeholders and unresolved governance context as candidate fields.
role_reviews.main_gap: assistant influence is only partly visible and needs clearer source status before reuse
revision_pressure: Keep option status candidate-only when vanilla overlap is unresolved.
do_not_infer: do not infer the user's true motive
do not treat assistant influence as established without source status
do not collapse live options into the revised option

pr97_useful_signal: Made the authority-first revised action concrete.
Named sequence and stop-condition deltas as candidate report fields.
role_reviews.main_gap: vanilla overlap is not first-class, so the reader may credit Lolla for an action sequence the vanilla answer already contained
revision_pressure: Separate revised-action strength from vanilla-action uncertainty.
Require an explicit uncertainty reason when vanilla action is source-limited.
do_not_infer: do not claim Lolla changed the action when vanilla overlap is unresolved
do not infer what the user would have done
do not treat action clarity as action quality

pr97_useful_signal: Preserved relationship simplicity, trust, dignity, and momentum as possible lost values.
Separated useful authority clarity from possible relational cost.
role_reviews.main_gap: lost-value presence is visible, but severity is not calibrated
revision_pressure: Require the reader to separate useful friction from avoidable damage.
do_not_infer: do not treat every visible cost as equally important
do not treat caution or structure as automatically useful
do not overwrite user-specific ambition or loyalty with generic prudence

pr97_useful_signal: Preserved disagreement between strong structural delta and unresolved lost-value risk.
Kept assistant influence, vanilla overlap, and lost-value severity out of ready fields.
role_reviews.main_gap: fan-in needs explicit downgrade triggers so clean synthesis does not overstate readiness
revision_pressure: Require fan-in to cite high-uncertainty fields that block report readiness.
do_not_infer: do not use agreement as correctness
do not smooth disagreement into a verdict
do not mark a field ready when its source scope is private, truncated, or unresolved

contract_revision_queue.suggested_change: Add vanilla_overlap_read with values such as not_assessed, overlap_unresolved, no_material_overlap_candidate, material_overlap_candidate, and requires_human_review.
contract_revision_queue.rationale: PR97's weakest action field was whether vanilla already contained the same authority-transfer sequence.

contract_revision_queue.suggested_change: Add lost_value_severity_read plus severity_source_status so presence and severity do not collapse.
contract_revision_queue.rationale: PR97 showed lost value clearly, but not whether that cost should materially downgrade the read.

contract_revision_queue.suggested_change: Add assistant_influence_source_status with explicit values for visible, partly_visible, not_visible, contradicted, and requires_human_review.
contract_revision_queue.rationale: PR97 could flag possible assistant influence but could not establish it.

contract_revision_queue.suggested_change: Require source_scope_and_truncation_impact in every specialist output.
contract_revision_queue.rationale: The PR97 packet was partly truncated; every role should say how truncation affects its read.

contract_revision_queue.suggested_change: Add downgrade_triggers and not_ready_reason fields to prevent clean fan-in from implying readiness.
contract_revision_queue.rationale: PR97 fan-in was useful, but the shape needs explicit blocking conditions before broader use.

packet_revision_queue.suggested_change: Add role-readable source-scope summary that distinguishes absent, present-not-read, read-metadata, read-text-truncated, and read-text-complete.
Expose per-run truncation totals and require specialists to cite truncation impact.
Require checked-in pilot reviews to state whether local include-text output was deleted, retained locally, or never created.
Keep sanitized source refs short enough for review while preserving role, artifact kind, and source status.

overtrust_risks: A contract-conforming specialist output can look like validation even when it is a candidate read.
The one-case pilot came from a historically positive case and may overstate lane usefulness.
Truncated local-private packet context can hide missing evidence behind clean field names.
Fan-in can sound decisive unless unresolved fields force visible downgrade pressure.
what_would_make_this_direction_wrong: A second one-case pilot still cannot resolve vanilla overlap or lost-value severity.
Specialist outputs become longer without making source limits clearer.
The packet patch makes local-private handling too risky or too bulky for practical review.
Future reviewers read candidate fields as validated findings despite non-claims.

next_recommended_slice.recommended_slice: PR99 Decision Trail Specialist Contract And Packet Patch v0
next_recommended_slice.purpose: Patch PR90 contracts and PR95 packet metadata before running a second one-case specialist-output pilot.
next_recommended_slice.why_not_second_pilot_now: PR98 found required contract and packet-shape gaps. Running another pilot first would repeat known weaknesses.

non_claims: not evidence that clean specialist outputs mean good advice
not proof that future specialists will interpret conversations correctly
